description: This file defines a PHP class 'ViewPopupview' that extends 'ViewListView' and manages the display and interaction of popup views within the SuiteCRM ModuleBuilder interface. It includes methods for construction, display logic, AJAX setup, Smarty template rendering, and title construction, primarily used for editing popup list views in the module builder context.

classes.name: ViewPopupview
classes.description: A class responsible for managing the popup view editing interface within the SuiteCRM ModuleBuilder, including rendering templates, handling AJAX navigation, and managing view states.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ViewPopupview object, setting module and layout parameters based on request variables, and translating module names when needed.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns the parameters to construct the module title in the UI, localized to 'Administration'.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: An empty placeholder method called before rendering the view.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the popup view either as a preview or via AJAX, fetching the appropriate Smarty template.

methods.name: constructAjax
methods.description: Builds and returns an AjaxCompose object with navigation breadcrumbs based on whether the view is part of ModuleBuilder or not.

methods.name: constructSmarty
methods.description: Prepares and returns a Smarty template object with assigned variables for rendering the list view, including buttons, headers, and localized strings.

methods.name: _constructTitle
methods.description: Constructs and returns the title string for the view, based on whether it is in ModuleBuilder or not.
